# Quality Indicator

This folder contains topics related to the quality indicators used by the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD) to monitor and evaluate the standard of care for patients with inflammatory bowel diseases and primary sclerosing cholangitis. The pages detail specific metrics tracked by the national steering group, ranging from diagnostic workups and medical treatment monitoring to surgical outcomes. It also covers the re-operation rate, a critical surgical quality parameter that triggers internal audits when departments exceed acceptable thresholds.

## Pages

- [[quality-indicator|Quality Indicator]] — Overview of the specific metrics tracked by DANIBD, including diagnostic workups, fecal calprotectin monitoring for biologic treatments, and systematic colonoscopy follow-ups for PSC patients.
- [[re-operationsrate]] — A critical surgical quality parameter tracking 30-day re-operation rates, which the steering group uses to trigger internal audits in underperforming departments.
